key.name: dock-position
key.description: Screen edge for dock placement: 'bottom', 'left', 'right', or 'top'

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Base icon size in pixels (24 to 96)

key.name: enable-magnification
key.description: Smooth icon zooming on mouse hover proximity

key.name: magnification-scale
key.description: Maximum zoom scale factor when hovering icons

key.name: autohide
key.description: Automatically hide dock when windows overlap

key.name: autohide-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before dock hides

key.name: show-trash
key.description: Include macOS-style Trash bin on the dock

key.name: show-launcher
key.description: Include Launchpad / App Grid icon on dock

key.name: launcher-position
key.description: Position of App Launcher button: 'start' or 'end'

key.name: indicator-style
key.description: Style of indicator mark for open apps: 'macos', 'ubuntu', or 'dash'

key.name: dock-corner-radius
key.description: Border radius for dock container in pixels

key.name: show-tooltips
key.description: Display application title tooltips on hover
